title: English Grammar Quiz — Easy
sub: Ten quick questions on tenses, word classes and sentence basics. Check yourself — no sign-up needed.
description: Free self-scoring English grammar quiz: ten quick questions on tenses, word classes and sentence basics, instant score, no sign-up.

questions.q: Which sentence is grammatically correct?
options: I goed to the store yesterday.
I will went to the store tomorrow.
I went to the store yesterday.
questions.answer: I went to the store yesterday.

questions.q: Which word is an adverb?
options: Table
Dog
Quickly
questions.answer: Quickly

questions.q: Which sentence is in the past tense?
options: I am eating dinner right now.
I will eat dinner in an hour.
I ate dinner an hour ago.
questions.answer: I ate dinner an hour ago.

questions.q: Which sentence is written in the passive voice?
options: The dog chased the cat.
The cat was chased by the dog.
The cat chased the dog.
questions.answer: The cat was chased by the dog.

questions.q: Which sentence contains a comparative adjective?
options: The pizza was the best.
The pizza was better than the pasta.
The pizza was good.
questions.answer: The pizza was better than the pasta.

questions.q: Which sentence is a conditional sentence?
options: I will go to the party tomorrow.
If I have time, I will go to the party.
I am happy when I see my friends.
questions.answer: If I have time, I will go to the party.

questions.q: Which sentence is in the present perfect tense?
options: I will go to Italy next year.
I have been to Italy three times.
I go to Italy every year.
questions.answer: I have been to Italy three times.

questions.q: Which sentence is a question?
options: This word is a problem.
Are you going to the party tonight?
The sky is blue.
questions.answer: Are you going to the party tonight?

questions.q: Which sentence contains a direct object?
options: She kicked the ball.
She ran quickly.
She sat down.
questions.answer: She kicked the ball.

questions.q: Which word is a preposition?
options: cat
happy
on
questions.answer: on

title: English Grammar Quiz — Medium
sub: Nine questions on gerunds, the passive, relative clauses and conditionals. Test yourself — no sign-up needed.
description: Free self-scoring English grammar quiz: nine questions on gerunds, the passive, relative clauses and conditionals, instant score.

questions.q: Which sentence is written in the subjunctive mood?
options: I wish I was at the beach.
If I were you, I would go to the party.
She demanded that he leaves immediately.
questions.answer: If I were you, I would go to the party.

questions.q: Which sentence contains a gerund?
options: The dog barks loudly at night.
He went to the store for some bread.
I like swimming in the ocean.
questions.answer: I like swimming in the ocean.

questions.q: Which sentence is written in the passive voice?
options: The students took the test.
The students were given a test by the teacher.
The teacher gave the students a test.
questions.answer: The students were given a test by the teacher.

questions.q: Which sentence contains a non-restrictive clause?
options: The car that I bought last month is very reliable.
My sister, who is a doctor, is visiting next week.
I need to buy some groceries that are on sale.
questions.answer: My sister, who is a doctor, is visiting next week.

questions.q: Which sentence contains an appositive phrase?
options: The book on the shelf is mine.
My friend, a doctor, is coming to visit next week.
The dog barked at the mailman.
questions.answer: My friend, a doctor, is coming to visit next week.

questions.q: Which sentence is an idiomatic expression?
options: She's feeling under the weather today.
I like to eat pizza on Fridays.
He drove to work this morning.
questions.answer: She's feeling under the weather today.

questions.q: Which sentence is in the conditional perfect tense?
options: I will study hard so that I can pass the test.
If I had studied harder, I would have passed the test.
I have studied for the test, but I'm not sure if I passed.
questions.answer: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the test.

questions.q: Which word is a conjunction?
options: quickly
and
on
questions.answer: and

questions.q: Which sentence is in the active voice?
options: The author wrote the book.
The book was written by the author.
The book is being written by the author.
questions.answer: The author wrote the book.

title: English Grammar Quiz — Hard
sub: Nine questions on modifiers, clauses, ellipsis and split infinitives. Test yourself — no sign-up needed.
description: Free self-scoring English grammar quiz: nine questions on modifiers, clauses, ellipsis and split infinitives, instant score.

questions.q: Which sentence contains a misplaced (dangling) modifier?
options: The car that he bought was a red sports car.
The dog in the park chased the ball.
Running through the park, the sun was shining brightly.
questions.answer: Running through the park, the sun was shining brightly.

questions.q: Which sentence contains an infinitive phrase?
options: The cat sat on the windowsill.
He is playing soccer with his friends.
I decided to go for a walk in the park.
questions.answer: I decided to go for a walk in the park.

questions.q: Which sentence is in the passive voice with a present participle?
options: The cat is sleeping on the couch.
The couch was slept on by the cat.
The couch is being slept on by the cat.
questions.answer: The couch is being slept on by the cat.

questions.q: Which sentence contains a restrictive clause?
options: The car, which is red, is mine.
My sister, who is a doctor, is visiting next week.
The book that I read last week was very interesting.
questions.answer: The book that I read last week was very interesting.

questions.q: Which sentence contains an ellipsis?
options: He ordered a pizza, and she a salad.
I'm not sure if I want to go, but you do.
She likes to run, swim, and hike.
questions.answer: He ordered a pizza, and she a salad.

questions.q: Which sentence contains a dangling participle?
options: Walking to school, the rain soaked me.
Walking to school, I got soaked.
I walked to school in the rain.
questions.answer: Walking to school, the rain soaked me.

questions.q: Which word is a relative pronoun?
options: That
Happy
Run
questions.answer: That

questions.q: Which sentence contains a split infinitive?
options: I want to quickly finish my homework.
I want to finish my homework quickly.
I quickly want to finish my homework.
questions.answer: I want to quickly finish my homework.

questions.q: Which sentence contains a modal verb?
options: He can swim very well.
He swims every day.
He swam yesterday.
questions.answer: He can swim very well.

title: English Grammar Quiz — Hardest
sub: Ten tough questions on absolute phrases, non-finite clauses and advanced constructions. Test yourself — no sign-up needed.
description: Free self-scoring English grammar quiz: ten tough questions on absolute phrases, non-finite clauses and advanced grammar.

questions.q: Which sentence contains a double negative?
options: I didn't see nobody at the party.
I can't hardly hear you.
I do have nothing to do today.
questions.answer: I didn't see nobody at the party.

questions.q: Which sentence contains an absolute phrase?
options: The cat sat on the windowsill.
The sun shining brightly, we decided to go for a walk.
He is playing soccer with his friends.
questions.answer: The sun shining brightly, we decided to go for a walk.

questions.q: Which sentence is in the simple passive voice with a past participle?
options: The cake is being baked by my mother.
The cake was baked by my mother.
My mother baked the cake.
questions.answer: The cake was baked by my mother.

questions.q: Which sentence contains a non-finite (infinitive) clause?
options: She stopped to rest for a while.
She stopped.
She was very tired.
questions.answer: She stopped to rest for a while.

questions.q: Which sentence contains an appositive phrase?
options: My brother, a talented artist, lives in Berlin.
My brother lives in Berlin.
My brother is a talented artist.
questions.answer: My brother, a talented artist, lives in Berlin.

questions.q: Which sentence is an example of a split construction?
options: I like to play, when I have free time, video games.
The girl, who was walking down the street, she waved at me.
The movie, that we watched last night, it was really good.
questions.answer: I like to play, when I have free time, video games.

questions.q: Which sentence is in the past perfect continuous tense?
options: I had been studying for hours when I finally took a break.
I studied for hours before I took a break.
I will study for hours before I take a break.
questions.answer: I had been studying for hours when I finally took a break.

questions.q: Which word is a preposition?
options: Quickly
Joyful
Under
questions.answer: Under

questions.q: Which sentence contains a dangling infinitive?
options: To get to the park, my bicycle was the fastest option.
To avoid the traffic, the car was driven on the side streets.
After the storm, the tree was knocked down.
questions.answer: To get to the park, my bicycle was the fastest option.

questions.q: Which sentence contains a phrasal-prepositional verb (verb + adverb + preposition)?
options: I look forward to the weekend.
I look at the picture.
I put on my coat.
questions.answer: I look forward to the weekend.
